title: Bill Todman Jr. touched a living UFO in a Teton meadow

tellings.quote: and he was climbing in the Tetons and he came up into this meadow and there was a UFO just sitting right hovering right there in the meadow

plain: A man named Bill Todman Jr. was climbing in the Tetons, the Wyoming mountain range, when he came up into a meadow and found a UFO "just sitting right hovering right there." By the story's title he touched it and took it to be alive. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells this to Michels as something he heard from Todman himself, and he also names two other men, Bob Rehme and Mason Neufeld, while telling it. If it were true, it would be a close, physical encounter with a craft that seemed to be a living thing.
